title: Spatial Feature-wise Linear Modulation (SpFiLM) for Contrast Agent-Aware Brain Parcellation
abstract: arXiv:2609.07718v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Most automated brain parcellation tools are developed and validated on T1-weighted (T1w) MRI. Yet, some clinical workflows for which parcellation is relevant only use contrast-enhanced T1w (T1ce) MRI, on which T1w-trained models are less accurate. We present a unified network that parcellates both pre- and post-contrast agent T1w MRI reliably, trained on a combination of the two with conditioning that spatially modulates its response differently for each. Feature-wise Linear Modulation (FiLM) is a known approach for input-based modulation in networks. It applies a per-channel scale and shift uniformly across the input. However, the appearance change between pre- and post-contrast varies locally across the brain, making FiLM suboptimal for our use case. In this work, we introduce Spatial FiLM (SpFiLM), a conditioning layer whose modulation varies spatially, assembling a voxel-wise scale and shift from image-derived spatial patterns. Usi

translated_title: 用于造影剂感知脑区分割的空间特征级线性调制（SpFiLM）
translated_abstract: 大多数自动化脑区分割工具都是在T1加权（T1w）MRI上开发和验证的。然而，某些与脑区分割相关的临床工作流程仅使用对比增强T1w（T1ce）MRI，而基于T1w训练的模型在此类图像上准确性较低。我们提出了一种统一的网络，能够可靠地对造影剂注射前后的T1w MRI进行脑区分割，该网络在两种图像的组合上进行训练，并通过条件化机制对每种模态产生不同的空间响应调制。特征级线性调制是网络中基于输入进行调制的已知方法，它在整个输入上均匀地应用逐通道的缩放和平移。然而，造影剂注射前后脑部外观的变化在脑内是局部性变化的，这使得FiLM在我们的应用场景中并非最优选择。在这项工作中，我们引入了空间FiLM（SpFiLM），这是一种调制随空间位置变化的条件化层，它从图像导出的空间模式中组装逐体素的缩放和平移。
tldr: 提出一种调制随空间变化的新型条件化层SpFiLM，使单一网络能够对造影剂注射前后的T1w脑部MRI均实现可靠的脑区分割。
en_tdlr: Proposes Spatial FiLM (SpFiLM), a spatially-varying conditioning layer that enables a single unified network to reliably parcellate brain structures on both pre- and post-contrast agent T1w MRI.
